title: LightGBM model predicts distant metastasis in papillary thyroid carcinoma
summary: A LightGBM model, the best of nine algorithms, used seven core features selected by LASSO, RFE and ReliefF in 2,452 patients with papillary thyroid carcinoma and reached test AUC 0.886 (accuracy 0.887, NPV 93.6%) but external AUC 0.758 in 432 patients. Extrathyroidal invasion and TgAb were the top SHAP predictors. External performance is substantially lower than internal, and the study is retrospective and from one country.
ai_technology: LightGBM (best of nine algorithms) on seven features selected by LASSO, RFE and ReliefF

evidence.tested: External validation on a cohort of 432 patients.
evidence.unknown: Prospective performance and clinical utility; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: A gradient boosting model predicted distant metastasis from clinical, pathological and ultrasound indices.
